concepts.why: The patient's ECG findings show a third-degree AV block with a minimum heart rate of 36 beats/min, indicating a high-grade atrioventricular block.
The patient's echocardiogram findings show a mean pulmonary arterial pressure of 32 mm Hg, indicating pulmonary hypertension.
The patient's echocardiogram findings show a left atrial volume index of 34.89 mL/m2, indicating left atrial enlargement.
The patient has a history of essential hypertension and presents with elevated blood pressure.
The patient's symptoms of syncope during exercise, combined with ECG findings of third-degree AV block, suggest cardiac syncope.
The patient reports dyspnea on exertion and exercise intolerance, which may be related to cardiac or pulmonary causes.
